items.title: Cash tile — owed to you
items.do_not_act: Do not act on this number until the source is established.
items.plain_english: The morning money card shows about Rp 128.5 billion as owed to you. That figure is the remaining balance on the Atrium apartment sales orderbook (contract total minus collected), not day-to-day trade receivables. Xero AR in the same snapshot is zero.

trace.calculation: scripts in wolf-system money-brain.py owed_to_you(): sum of BALANCE_ROW across unit columns = contract_total − collected_total
trace.underlying_records: Atrium apartment sales Google Sheet unit columns; outstanding ≈ Rp 128,532,978,747 from contract − collected
trace.source_system: Atrium apartment sales sheet via command-brief / money-brain
trace.transformation: Sheet balances bucketed under GGV pipeline and labelled owed to you / receivables
trace.where_it_breaks: Mislabel: an apartment sales orderbook is presented as money owed to you. It is not hotel AR and must not be collected as trade debt. ar_invoiced_total = real receivables. owed_total_blended mixes in the Atrium sales pipeline (an orderbook) and must NOT be read as AR. Pipeline is also currently bucketed under AMG though Atrium Apartments sales are a GGV line — flagged for money-brain's own fix.
trace.what_would_settle: A commissioned AR figure from the GGV invoice and receipt books, kept separate from the apartment sales pipeline.

items.money_brain_note: ar_invoiced_total = real receivables. owed_total_blended mixes in the Atrium sales pipeline (an orderbook) and must NOT be read as AR. Pipeline is also currently bucketed under AMG though Atrium Apartments sales are a GGV line — flagged for money-brain's own fix.

items.title: Atrium occupancy
items.do_not_act: Do not act on this number until the source is established.
items.plain_english: The Atrium tile shows 1.75% occ occupancy. That is Cloudbeds percentageOccupied for today (rooms occupied 2 ÷ capacity 114). It is a live dashboard snapshot, not a closed night-audit of rooms sold ÷ rooms available.

trace.calculation: command-brief collect_atrium() copies Cloudbeds getDashboard.percentageOccupied; check 2/114 ≈ 1.75%
trace.underlying_records: Cloudbeds getDashboard for Atrium Suites Lombok (today)
trace.transformation: Displayed verbatim as '1.75% occ' on the master board
trace.where_it_breaks: Docstrings still say 120 rooms; live capacity is 114. The tile does not state the date basis. Low occupancy may be real for the moment, but it is not a settled hotel night figure.
trace.what_would_settle: Authorised night-audit rooms sold ÷ rooms available for a named business date, with the room count commissioned.

items.title: Alchemist payable — broken records
items.do_not_act: Do not act on this number until the source is established.
items.plain_english: The Alchemist tile shows unpaid payables Rp 62,950,910 and 55 broken rows. Broken means a purchase request is still status Received while its linked ledger row is already paid. That is a desync to investigate, not a bank-beats-Alchemist rule.

trace.displayed_value: alchemist_tile compute_five(): unpaid SUM(amount) + broken count
trace.calculation: owe = SUM(ledger.amount) WHERE payment_status='unpaid'; broken = COUNT pr_orders JOIN ledger WHERE status='Received' AND payment_status='paid'
trace.underlying_records: 55 PR numbers listed on this register
trace.transformation: Tile shortens the desync to 'broken N' next to the unpaid total
trace.where_it_breaks: Received PRs remain linked to paid ledger rows. Nota files for these 55 are not on the local disk even when a Drive URL exists. Bank lines were not used as AP proof.
trace.what_would_settle: For each PR: PO lines, receiving evidence, nota file on disk, and a consistent ledger state. Do not invent a bank-beats-Alchemist rule.
